subject: [AMBER] I cannot find NAB in AmberTools 21

messages.author: russ.brown.yahoo.com
messages.body: I have (apparently) successfully installed AmberTools 21 under Mac OS X Monterey but I cannot find NAB. In which directory is NAB located?

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Mar 15, 2022, russ.brown.yahoo.com wrote:
>I have (apparently) successfully installed AmberTools 21 under Mac OS X
>Monterey but I cannot find NAB. In which directory is NAB located?
The executable should be $AMBERHOME/bin/nab; source code is in
amber20_src/AmberTools/src/nab.
If you have time, please post some details of how you got things to work on
Monterey.  In particular, what fortran compiler did you use?  Are you using
an Intel or M1 chip?
....dac
